_about: Written by validation/python/reference_mesh.py (independent MESH reference) and reference_fug.py (shortcut). Regenerate: python validation/python/reference_mesh.py. The cases and their conventions: validation/data/columns/. Converged reference profiles are not validated against data.

A1-binary-alpha.title: Binary, constant relative volatility 2.5, total condenser

mccabe_thiele.why: an exact construction for constant relative volatility and constant molar overflow: only rounding

total_reflux.why: Fenske is exact at total reflux; at R = 1e4 the remaining difference is of the order of 1/R

shortcut.note: recoveries of the rigorous solution; Gilliland's N is a correlation, shown for information, not a check

A2-ternary-alpha-fug.title: Ternary, constant relative volatilities 4 : 2 : 1, keys A and B, shortcut

rmin_against_rigorous.expected: close to 1: Underwood is exact for constant alpha and constant molar overflow at infinitely many stages; 100 stages need a little more, and the rigorous column puts less of the heavy non-key C in the distillate than Fenske's estimate in the shortcut's x_D, which lowers it a little

A3-ternary-partial-condenser.title: Ternary, constant relative volatilities 4 : 2 : 1, partial condenser, two-phase feed

A4-binary-two-feeds.title: Binary, constant relative volatility 2.5, two feeds (a liquid and a half-vaporized feed)

mccabe_thiele.why: an exact construction for constant relative volatility and constant molar overflow: only rounding

B1-ethanol-water-nrtl.title: Ethanol + water, NRTL, 20 stages, subcooled feed

B2-chemsep-benzene-toluene.title: Benzene + toluene, 10 stages, saturated-liquid feed: the worked example of The ChemSep Book, section 1.2

published.note: For information and for the agreement tolerances of the case; the published numbers come from another property method (UNIFAC, ChemSep's Antoine equations, constant molar overflow).

B3-acetone-methanol-azeotrope.title: Acetone + methanol, NRTL, 50 stages, reflux ratio 6: the distillate pinches just below the azeotrope

C1-missing-pair.title: Methanol + water + ethylene glycol, NRTL: a pair without parameters

D1-dry-stage.title: Binary, constant relative volatility 2.5, reflux ratio 0.001: the rectifying section runs dry

E1-shortcut-below-minimum-reflux.title: The A2 shortcut with a reflux ratio below Underwood's minimum

shortcut.message: the reflux ratio 2 is at or below the minimum reflux ratio 2.17643 (Underwood): no number of stages reaches the specified recoveries

E2-negative-boilup.title: Binary, constant relative volatility 2.5, saturated vapour feed, distillate too small

boilup.why: constant molar overflow is exact for this model system: the boil-up would be negative, so no column has these specifications

E3-purity-above-azeotrope.title: Ethanol + water, NRTL: a distillate purity above the azeotrope

E4-iteration-limit.title: Ethanol + water (the B1 column) with an iteration limit of one: not converged

F1-butanol-water-two-liquids.title: 1-Butanol + water, NRTL, 6 stages: the top stages lie inside the two-liquid region

P1-performance-alcohols-water.title: Performance benchmark: methanol + ethanol + 1-propanol + water, NRTL, 40 stages
